subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should `claws export` remain fail-closed for every drifted or incomplete installation, or should OpenClaw support a separately acknowledged snapshot export with explicit drift and lineage metadata?
rationale: Both approaches are product contracts for a portable operating-role artifact; source review cannot decide the acceptable trade-off between reproducibility guarantees and recovery/export utility.

options.title: Keep exact-state export
options.body: Retain fail-closed export for any incomplete or drifted managed state and defer snapshot support until its provenance contract is designed.

options.title: Add explicit snapshot mode
options.body: Allow degraded export only behind a separately named mode that emits a machine-readable drift report and complete source lineage.

options.title: Pause the export surface
options.body: Defer this command until the wider Claws lifecycle stack and its artifact semantics receive maintainer sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Keep exact-state export
recommendation.body: Retain fail-closed export for any incomplete or drifted managed state and defer snapshot support until its provenance contract is designed.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the stacked export and lifecycle proposal and is best positioned to incorporate a maintainer-selected contract.
